2609.28107.title: Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching
2609.28107.paper_summary: Advances in generative modeling have recently been extensively employed in robotics for policy learning. In particular, Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) trained with expert demonstrations has been shown to outperform existing methods on robot manipulation benchmarks. While prior work has mainly focused on single-task settings, we study the problem from a multi-task perspective, as training independent models for each task is computationally expensive. Multi-Task policy learning comes with its own set of challenges, as naively training on a concatenated dataset of demonstrations would either require increased model capacity to accommodate the added complexity or result in drops in performance. We propose to distill knowledge from single-task CFM experts into a shared multi-task policy by transferring their learned velocity fields. We combine this distillation signal with the original CFM objective to retain fidelity to the demonstrations. Experiments on RLBench show that our approach improves multi-task policy performance over naive training while maintaining a fixed model size.
2609.28107.paper_summary_zh: 在生成模型方面的進展最近被廣泛應用於機器人政策學習。<lb/>特別是，使用專家示範訓練的條件流匹配（CFM）已被證明在機器人操作基準上超越現有方法。<lb/>雖然之前的工作主要集中在單任務設置上，但我們從多任務的角度研究這個問題，因為為每個任務訓練獨立模型在計算上是昂貴的。<lb/>多任務政策學習有其自身的一套挑戰，因為簡單地在連接的示範數據集上進行訓練要麼需要增加模型容量以適應增加的複雜性，要麼會導致性能下降。<lb/>我們提出從單任務CFM專家中提煉知識，通過轉移他們學習的速度場來形成共享的多任務政策。<lb/>我們將這個提煉信號與原始CFM目標結合，以保持對示範的忠實度。<lb/>在RLBench上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在保持固定模型大小的同時，改善了多任務政策性能，超越了簡單訓練。
